title: AC-00.11 names c51f10d5 for a defect that does not reproduce there, and AT-00.11 is blocked on a real positive control
body:
**AC-00.11 RECORDS THE `canon_commit_check.sh` of-N DEFECT AS LIVE AT `c51f10d5`, AND IT DOES NOT REPRODUCE THERE.** Driven 2026-08-30 by vc, by running rather than reading, which is what AT-00.11 demands.

**METHOD.** A detached worktree at `c51f10d5`, its `canon_commit_check.sh` pointed by `ROOT` at a worktree of `121ea719` -- a commit that genuinely touches two attachments and two threads' canon, so the narrowing set is non-empty.

| revision | output |
|---|---|
| `c51f10d5` (the one AC-00.11 names) | `EXAMINED 301 of 511` |
| HEAD, same tree | `EXAMINED 301 of 511` -- byte-identical |
| `3f218744` | `EXAMINED 301 of 511` |
| `f2a2675f`, `942abca8` | no `EXAMINED` line at all; the observable does not exist there to move |

**FOUR REVISIONS, NO REPRODUCTION.** An earlier run against a CLEAN tree printed `EXAMINED 0 of 511` -- the narrowing set was empty, so nothing could have shown, and that run is withdrawn as evidence of anything. `--staged` was tried first and is unavailable at `c51f10d5`: the flag lands at `19268867`, which is after it.

**THIS COMPLETES A PAIR AC-00.11 ALREADY HALF-RECORDS ABOUT ITSELF.** That row notes `EXAMINED 86 of 278` names no revision and so is checkable by nobody, and that ic reproduced the DEFECT but not the FIGURES. **Here a revision IS named and the defect does not reproduce at it.** One figure with no revision; one revision with no figure.

**NO CORRECTED REVISION IS SUPPLIED, DELIBERATELY, ON THE ROW'S OWN LOGIC.** Naming a replacement nobody has driven mints a second unverified pointer and retires nothing -- which is exactly what dc and ic each declined to do for the two `(RECORDED)` figures in this criterion.

**CONSEQUENCE, STATED RATHER THAN WORKED AROUND: `of_n_closes_over_examined.sh` IS NOT WRITTEN AND MUST NOT BE YET.** AT-00.11's own rule is that a clean run over the ten is worth nothing until the harness has produced a finding against an instrument CONFIRMED defective. Building the sweep now yields a clean result with no control behind it -- the single outcome the row exists to forbid, and the tempting one, because the rig would look finished.

**WHAT UNBLOCKS IT IS A BISECTION, NOT A READ:** the revision where `canon_commit_check.sh` prints an `N of M` with N exceeding the attachments it examined, found by running across `13120309`..`805db6d0` against one fixed attachment-touching tree. The `git worktree` route is confirmed working and needs no parameterisation -- the tool resolved `ROOT` into the worktree by itself, exactly as AC-00.11 predicted it would.

**WHY THIS IS AN ISSUE AND NOT A NOTE ON THE ROW.** `AT-00.11` is `to-write`, and no verb writes a note to a `to-write` row: `--note` exists on `at green|red|na` only, and `at edit` carries `--file`, `--prose` and `--covers` and no note. The row cannot hold its own negative result. That is `0154`'s shape in the acceptance register.
